twin.homeLead: Each card is a real project. Its four numbers come from the project's own repository (commits, reach, checks and pace), its moves are the product's real features, and its live link opens the product.
twin.playLine: Pick three cards whose inks add up to {budget} or less and play them against three more at {url}.
twin.holds: The battle holds {n} of the {total} cards today.
twin.battleLead: {name}'s card battle is a free browser game in which three of his project cards play three more. The engine is deterministic: the same teams and seed always play the same battle.
twin.teams: Teams: {size} cards whose inks add up to {budget} or less.
twin.modes: Two modes share one engine. Mat plays the battle on a card mat with a cutscene for every move. Arena plays it on a painted floor, with eight original trainer figures.
twin.aboutCards: This site shows {n} of the projects as collectible cards. Every number on a card has a receipt from the project's repository.
twin.everyPageTwin: Every page has a Markdown twin: add .md to its path, or send {accept}.
